topic: Bancos de Dados Locais (SQLite, Redis, MongoDB)
rules: Instalar e iniciar serviços sob demanda no Termux.

recipes.trigger: criar banco de dados sqlite com tabela
recipes.command: pkg install -y sqlite && sqlite3 database.sqlite "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP); INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ('VerySystems'); SELECT * FROM users;"
pkg install -y redis && redis-server --daemonize yes && redis-cli ping
